Hi Liam — welcome, and thanks for the materials.

Quick read: I reviewed the W-9 and the EIN table. Two things before we can push a staged PO:

1) Tax attestation: because there are multiple EINs we need an explicit attestation from your legal that both entities are related (affiliate declaration) or confirmation that the first entity is authorized to invoice for the project scope. A short signed statement (PDF) is sufficient.

2) PO policy: Redwood procurement can create a conditional PO to Greenwave US LLC for initial milestone work up to 50% of the contract value; the remainder will be released once the second entity's tax docs and bank details clear KYC. If you prefer a different split, mention it and we'll evaluate.

Next steps: Please send the attestation and confirm whether Greenwave accepts a staged PO at 50% now. Monica (cc'd) will prepare the conditional PO terms; Jordan will validate tax fields in our supplier master.

If you want, we can set a 15-min call today to accelerate.
